pageDescription: Official licenses and permits of PT Equityworld Futures
aboutDescription: PT Equityworld Futures operates within Indonesia’s national regulatory framework and is directly supervised by the Commodity Futures Trading Regulatory Agency (Bappebti). All company activities follow government standards on supervision, protection, and governance to ensure that futures trading is conducted in a transparent, trustworthy, and fully compliant manner.

legalitasItems.title: Deed of Establishment of Limited Liability Company
legalitasItems.description: Established under Deed No. 01 dated 2 July 2005 by Notary Tan Susy, S.H., under the original name PT Goldmany Futures.

legalitasItems.title: Ministry of Law and Human Rights Ratification
legalitasItems.description: Ratified by the Ministry of Law and Human Rights through Decree No. C-29097 HT.01.010 TH.2005.

legalitasItems.title: Deed of Name Change
legalitasItems.description: The company’s name was officially changed to PT Equityworld Futures under Deed No. 11 dated 4 November 2008 by Notary Tan Susy, S.H.

legalitasItems.title: Ministry of Law and Human Rights Ratification of Name Change
legalitasItems.description: Name change ratified by the Ministry of Law and Human Rights through Decree No. AHU-95798.AH.01.02.2008.

legalitasItems.title: Stock Exchange Member Approval Letter (SPAB)
legalitasItems.description: Registered as a member of the Jakarta Futures Exchange (JFX) under SPAB No. SPAB-143/BBJ/09/05.

legalitasItems.title: Futures Brokerage Business License
legalitasItems.description: Futures brokerage business license granted under the Decision of the Head of Bappebti No. 850/BAPPEBTI/SI/12/2005.

legalitasItems.title: Indonesia Clearing House Membership
legalitasItems.description: Officially registered as a member of Indonesia Clearing House (KBI) under No. 36/AK-KBI/IV/2006.

legalitasItems.title: Alternative Trading System Cooperation Agreement
legalitasItems.description: Cooperation agreement on the Alternative Trading System with PT Royal Assetindo under Letter No. 162/GM/DIR/V/2006.

legalitasItems.title: BAPPEBTI Decree for SPA Participant
legalitasItems.description: Approved as a Participant of the Alternative Trading System (SPA) under Bappebti Decree No. 1524/BAPPEBTI/SP/4/2007.

legalitasItems.title: BAPPEBTI Decree for Name Change
legalitasItems.description: Approval of the name change from PT Goldmany Futures to PT Equityworld Futures under Bappebti Decree No. 05/BAPPEBTI/PN/3/2009.

legalitasItems.title: Online Futures Broker
legalitasItems.description: Designation as a Futures Broker authorized to conduct electronic (online) client onboarding in the field of Commodity Futures Trading under Bappebti Decree No. 26/BAPPEBTI/KEP-PBK/08/2014.
